lessonTitle: Addition and Subtraction on the Number Line

stageA.sourceSpecificSummary: IM 2021 Grade2 Unit4 Lesson7 Addition and Subtraction on the Number Line. Warm-up Notice and Wonder shows two authentic0..15 lines connecting8 and12 with opposite arrow directions; 8+4=12 moves RIGHT four equal units, 12−4=8 moves LEFT four. The mathematical START and LENGTH matter in matching an equation, even when commutativity gives the same sum. Original Activity1 displays four numbered diagrams and two candidate equations each: arrow10→15 represents10+5=15; 13→5 represents13−8=5;12→2 represents12−10=2;4→14 represents4+10=14, not10+4=14 because actual start4. Students must view genuine publisher images with a teacher to justify the arrow's direction and endpoints. Activity2 original matching asks students to cut and glue eight equation strips by lettered line A–H, with ONE original unmatched equation that pupils draw on a blank number line; original line details include A6→18, B10→3,C9→14,D12→18,E3→20,F3→10,G20→17 and H blank. Teacher checks original image matches and actual paper cuts; independently authored digital computations are not substituted for visual grading. Original restricted Cool-down not copied.
stageA.sourceImageAndHumanBoundary: Original teacher number-line images, physical student arrows, peer discourse and restricted publisher Cool-down not fabricated
